meta.title: Lineup Lab Full Requirements Traceability Matrix

rows.requirement: Collect, organize, and analyze NFL data against a full requirements list
rows.verification_summary: 21 explicit requirements mapped 1-to-1 to deterministic scripts, JSON outputs, and automated verifier checks.

rows.requirement: Dedicated Suggestions section evaluating improvements to site and decision-making before implementing changes
rows.verification_summary: 10 structured proposals (SUG-01..SUG-10) comparing Option A/B tradeoffs, expected decision impact, and reviewer approval status.

rows.requirement: Clear list of questions, information, and answers needed before decisions based on Have vs Don't Have + discovery suggestions
rows.verification_summary: 14 decision questions (Q-01..Q-14) explicitly separating verified datasets from missing defensive snaps, prop prices, and opening lines, with concrete ingestion paths.

rows.requirement: Originate own NFL spreads, totals, and fair moneylines out-of-sample
rows.verification_summary: Walk-forward L2 ridge model (alpha tuned on 2015-2017) evaluated on 2018-2026 OOS + all 14 live Week 10 (Nov 12-16) matchups.

rows.requirement: Originate player-prop projections (passing, rushing, receiving yards, receptions)
rows.verification_summary: Ex-ante player prop medians and depth-cascade adjustments computed; sportsbook Week 10 prop lines left blank and flagged as missing.

rows.requirement: Research and develop pre-kickoff strategies for generating useful signals
rows.verification_summary: 12 pre-kickoff signals (model edges, rest/bye, wind totals, QB backup downgrade, defensive EPA shock) tested strictly on stored odds.

rows.requirement: Treat strategy evaluation as a leaderboard competition with rewards for top performers
rows.verification_summary: 10,000-pt paper allocation pool across 16 strategies; cash prize column strictly blank because no funded prize pool is verified.

rows.requirement: Cover single bets, cross-game parlays, SGPs, and player-prop bet combos
rows.verification_summary: 16 strategies across Single Bets, 2/3-Leg Parlays, SGPs, Player-Prop Combos, and Lookahead Control; unpriced SGP/prop ROI cells strictly blank.

rows.requirement: Require every strategy to pass strict validation gates (G1-G10) before earning rewards
rows.verification_summary: 10 gates enforced; 0/16 pass all gates; G1 disqualifies lookahead control STR-16; G9/G10 block unverified execution/prop combos.

rows.requirement: Determine empirical correlation values across games, sides/totals, and player props
rows.verification_summary: 16 correlation pairs with 95% Fisher-z CIs, Gaussian-copula SGP joint pricing curves, and ex-ante vs ex-post WR1 bias test.

rows.requirement: Remove luck from the equation and build selectively skill-based strategies
rows.verification_summary: Pythagorean R^2, YoY luck persistence, odd/even split-half correlation, Empirical Bayes ROI shrinkage, and BH FDR correction.

rows.requirement: Track injuries and know offensive/defensive deficiencies when 2nd, 3rd, or 4th string backups replace starters
rows.verification_summary: Empirical 2015-2026 starter vs QB2/QB3/WR2/WR3/RB2 dropoff + team defense shock study combined with live Week 10 injury/depth-chart cascades across 9 clubs.

rows.requirement: Create an executive summary outlining key details
rows.verification_summary: Consolidated executive briefing reconciled directly against JSON outputs and Week 10 official league reports.

rows.requirement: Review repo line by line against official sources, provide manual-review links, and flag irregularities
rows.verification_summary: 16 line-by-line repository & upstream feed audits (REV-01..REV-16) including CI workflow bugs, -110 imputation lines, stale extracts, and official standings checks.

rows.requirement: Clean GitHub Pages dashboard UI with landing page and categorized subpages in easy-to-read table format
rows.verification_summary: 12 deterministic HTML pages under lineup-lab/ with shared navigation, KPI summaries, and clean structured tables.

rows.requirement: Every HTML table row carries an official source link; unconfirmable values stay blank and flagged
rows.verification_summary: 100% row-level official source compliance (0 audit/check_site.py flags) and strict empty-cell enforcement for 16 flagged items.

rows.requirement: No inferred/guessed values, no -110 price imputation, no fabricated cash prizes or prop odds
rows.verification_summary: Automated strict RFC 8259 JSON parse checks and HTML blank-cell verification reject any inferred placeholder.

rows.requirement: Coordinate via COORDINATION.md with non-overlapping scope and pull --rebase before every push
rows.verification_summary: Claimed lineup-lab/**, .github/workflows/lineup-lab.yml, and dedicated COORDINATION.md section without modifying sibling files.

rows.requirement: Automated CI verification before PR merge so broken builds cannot merge
rows.verification_summary: Dedicated GitHub Actions workflow + full repository checks (tests/check_site.py, audit/check_site.py, validate_data.py).

rows.requirement: Flagged irregularities and unverified items do not block merge and publish on Flagged for Review page
rows.verification_summary: All 16 flagged items published with reason, impacted metric, and official manual-review links.

rows.requirement: Open PR to main, merge autonomously after checks pass, verify live GitHub Pages URL, and record in COORDINATION.md
rows.implementation: gh pr create + gh pr merge --merge + live Pages check + COORDINATION.md log
rows.verification_summary: To be finalized after local and CI verification pass.
